statutory_provisions: PC Act s.7, s.13(1)(d) read with s.13(2); Cr.P.C. s.306, s.460(g)
confession: Confessional statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. recorded; relied on
neutral_facts: The accused, a government official, was involved in a case of corruption. The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) registered a case against him for demanding a bribe. During the investigation, the accused and another individual were caught accepting a bribe. The CBI sought pardon for the second individual to assist in the investigation. The Metropolitan Magistrate granted pardon to the second individual, which was later challenged. The case was framed against the accused, and he was examined as a witness. The Special Judge rejected the challenge to the pardon, and the High Court dismissed the appeal. The Supreme Court held that the Metropolitan Magistrate had the power to grant pardon during the investigation, and the order was not a curable irregularity.
